name: inD: Intersection Drone Trajectory Dataset
description: Naturalistic traffic trajectory dataset recorded from aerial drones above four urban intersections in Germany, providing centimeter-accurate positional tracks for 11,500 diverse road users including vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians.

license.name: levelXData Non-Commercial Academic License
license.notes: Freely accessible for non-commercial academic research upon registration with levelXData.

source_references.title: inD Dataset Official Portal
source_references.notes: Official portal with dataset statistics, sensor configuration, and academic download request form.

source_references.title: The inD Dataset: A Trajectory Dataset of Naturalistic Urban Traffic Collected from a Drone
source_references.notes: IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2020) publication by Bock et al. introducing the intersection trajectory benchmark.

verification.notes: Verified against levelXData inD portal and IEEE IV 2020 publication (DOI: 10.1109/IV47402.2020.9304839).

size.notes: levelXData distributes individual CSV files per recording after academic registration approval; a single fixed aggregate archive size is not officially published.

citation.paper_title: The inD Dataset: A Trajectory Dataset of Naturalistic Urban Traffic Collected from a Drone

provenance.collection_method: Recorded using 4K cameras mounted on hovering drones above four complex urban intersections in Aachen, Germany.
provenance.curation_notes: Provides naturalistic trajectories for 11,500 road users including cars, trucks, buses, pedestrians, and cyclists across 10 hours of video recordings, specifically capturing complex urban intersection conflicts.
